subject: How do I run a self-test on a Tidewater T2 pump?

comments.author: Rob Tallis
comments.body: New tech on our floor is asking how to run the built-in self-test. Where's that documented?

comments.author: Halvard Support
comments.body: It's in the quick-start card, section 3 — hold the check button for 3 seconds at power-on.
